snippet.title: Bouncing Animals | Trailer
snippet.description:
A relaxing game about bouncing beautiful animal balls.

Webpage: https://scardivargames.com/bouncinganimals
Google Play Link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ScardivarsGames.BouncingAnimals
App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bouncing-animals/id1616554716

Bouncing Animals is a video game designed to offer a relaxing and ASMR experience to all players, with a very unique art style, and pleasant music. The game is easy and enjoyable, with simple mechanics that everyone can understand and enjoy, and a story told by someone who is both nice and bad at the same time, and if you don't believe me, read this:

Hello dear user, before you start this test, we are not responsible for what happens to you during the course of it.

Now, bounce those balls!

Main features:
👀A pleasant game to the senses.
😌A relaxing and ASMR experience in all aspects.
🗺An interesting inside story.
🦊Numerous balls based on known animals.
🏐Different ways to bounce the balls.
🤓Curiosities about each animal that you did not know.

© 2026 Scardivar's Games. Developed and published by Scardivar's Games.
